Bill.BriefDescription: Allocating state sales and use tax revenue derived from the state department of transportation expenditures to the motor vehicle account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allocating state sales and use tax revenuederived from state department of transportation expenditures to themotor vehicle account; adding a new section to chapter 82.32 RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 43.135 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By the last workday of the first and third calendar quarters,the state treasurer must transfer the amount specified in subsection(2) of this section from the general fund to the motor vehicle account.The first two transfers under this subsection (1) must occur bySeptember 30, 2014, and April 30, 2015. (2)(a) The department must estimate the state general fund revenuesderived from expenditures by the state department of transportation.The department must perform the estimate for tax collections in theimmediately preceding third and fourth calendar quarters for the Apriltransfer under subsection (1) of this section and tax collections inthe immediately preceding first and second calendar quarters for theSeptember transfer under subsection (1) of this section. The p. 1 HB 2094department must notify the state treasurer of this amount at leasttwenty days prior to the April or September transfer under subsection(1) of this section. (b) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply. (i) "Digital product" has the meaning provided in RCW 82.04.192. (ii) "Expenditures by the state department of transportation" meansamounts paid by the state department of transportation with respect tothe purchase of any tangible personal property, digital product, orlabor, which is subject to state sales or use tax.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.135 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: RCW 43.135.034(4) does not apply to the transfers under section 1of this act.
